flowContents.name: DigitrafficRail
flowContents.comments: Finnish rail: full train timetables and GPS positions, pushed by Digitraffic MQTT (wss://rata.digitraffic.fi/mqtt). No key, no polling.

processors.name: Publish digitraffic-locations
processors.comments: Kafka topic digitraffic-locations, one message per record, key = trainKey
